title: Atmospheric
summary: ATMOSPHER'IC, ATMOSPHER'ICAL, adjective 1. Pertaining to the atmosphere; as atmospheric air or vapors. 2. Dependent on the atmosphere. I am an atmospheric creature.

inlines.v: ATMOSPHER'IC, ATMOSPHER'ICAL, adjective 1. Pertaining to the atmosphere; as atmospheric air or vapors. 2. Dependent on the atmosphere. I am an atmospheric creature.
